I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket is PD-4821.

It comes from #central-team, which Tobias is a member of. On 9 Jun 2026 Hollis posted that PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import attached. I also passed on the open problem Hollis raised: the import file labels doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. Hollis wanted that sorted before anyone reimports, to avoid duplicates. I haven't seen any later message saying it was fixed.

The gbrain search was refused again for the same reason as before: the connection's token isn't linked to any member, so nothing was read from the brain. Someone with admin access to the brain server still needs to fix that token.
